title: Robots marched with signs in Poland to protect human jobs from AI
title_candidates: AI robots in Poland held a real protest against AI replacing human workers
Robots marched with signs in Poland to protect human jobs from AI
The robots in Poland protesting to save your job from being taken by AI
AI robots in Poland just organized a march against AI job losses
These robots in Poland demanded that humans keep their jobs from AI
caption:
In Poland, AI-powered robots took to the streets with signs, protesting against AI replacing human workers.

The irony is hard to miss. These are machines, built and run by AI, demanding that people keep their jobs. The event hit a nerve immediately because it made something abstract feel real: automation is already moving fast enough through European industries that people are looking for any way to slow it down, even staging protests with the very tools they fear.

Robots holding signs in the street is something people have pictured for decades. Here it actually happened.
